The user-selector input is bound to 'usernames', so stale usernames persist after a successful add, and the next Add click submits them again. judged_text: addMembers ships with the acknowledged 'TODO: should clear the input' — the user-selector retains the just-added usernames after the Add action succeeds. The next Add click re-submits the previous usernames along with any new ones (e.g. 'alice,bob' when only bob was intended), so every subsequent add carries stale members whose re-addition is either a silent no-op or a server error depending on Group#add's dedup behavior.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `addMembers` action sends `this.get("usernames")` to `model.addMembers(...)` but never clears/reset that bound `usernames` value afterward (`// TODO: should clear the input`). In `group.hbs`, the `user-selector` is bound to `usernames=usernames`, so the UI state will retain the previously-added usernames unless the component clears itself (not shown in this diff). A subsequent click on “Add” would therefore re-submit the stale usernames along with any new ones the user typed, causing duplicate add attempts.
